question: Can the publication-mediated 1950-01-29 Deng Zhicheng diary quotation about Zhao Wanli purchasing twelve boxes of Tieqin Tongjian Lou books for public custody be moved onto a direct facsimile inspection route, and can the target volume of the eight-volume facsimile set be closed without yet claiming the entry text has been directly collated?
answer: Yes. National Library Press's first-party product page closes the 2007 eight-volume 《邓之诚日记（外五种）》 as a facsimile edition of Deng Zhicheng's unpublished diary manuscripts, ISBN 9787501334773, published 2007-07-11. Its detailed table of contents places diary notebook 14, covering 1949-01-29 through 1950-02-16, in volume 5. Therefore the 1950-01-29 target entry is securely in facsimile volume 5. CiNii independently closes the edition as an eight-volume facsimile, NCID BA83843361, and exposes exact volume-5 item identifiers at four Japanese libraries. The project has not directly reviewed the 1950-01-29 facsimile page, so the quoted wording about forty million People's Currency, twelve boxes, and public custody remains publication-mediated pending direct image collation. No target 3482/3483 transaction route is selected.
